intro.title: In Benin, selling happens on WhatsApp
intro.p1: Your clients don't fill in contact forms: they send a WhatsApp message. And they expect an answer within minutes, not the next day. A business that replies in ten minutes wins the client of a business that replies in two days, even if the latter is better.
intro.p2: A WhatsApp chatbot does not replace your sales people. It handles first contact: it acknowledges the message, asks the three or four useful questions, filters out irrelevant requests, then hands over to a human with the file already filled in. The rest — creating the client record, sending the quote, following up — is handled by n8n or Make.

comparison.title: n8n or Make: which one?
comparison.desc: Both work. The choice depends on your budget, your volume and how sensitive your data is.

rows.n8n: Self-hostable on your own server, or cloud version.
rows.make: Cloud only, on the vendor's servers.

rows.n8n: Your data can stay entirely on your infrastructure.
Fixed hosting cost, independent of the number of operations.
rows.make: Billed per operation: cost climbs with volume.
Very fast for connecting common tools.

rows.n8n: Very flexible, you can write code when needed.
rows.make: Enough for most cases, more limited at the extremes.
More accessible interface for non-technical users.

comparison.conclusion: In practice we often start on Make to validate a scenario quickly, then move to n8n when volume grows or when the data is sensitive. We tell you which one to pick during the diagnostic, based on your real numbers.

items.q: Do I need a WhatsApp Business API account?
items.a: For reliable automated professional use, yes. We guide you through creating and verifying the account and we configure the number. For simpler needs there are intermediate options that we assess during the diagnostic.

items.q: Will the chatbot replace my team?
items.a: No, and that isn't the goal. It handles first contact and repetitive questions, which is often the majority of messages. Your team picks up already-qualified requests and spends its time on those worth a human conversation.

items.q: Will my clients realise it's a bot?
items.a: We recommend stating it clearly in the first message: it is more honest and better received. The assistant explains that it is preparing the file before an advisor takes over, and it hands over as soon as the client asks.

items.q: How much does AI automation cost in Benin?
items.a: The cost has two parts: the setup, which depends on the number of scenarios and tools to connect, and the monthly usage, which depends on message volume and the chosen platform. We price both in the quote issued after the diagnostic, in FCFA, so you can compare it with what lost requests currently cost you.

items.q: Which CRM does it work with?
items.a: Most of them. We connect either a market CRM or an Airtable or Notion base if you don't have a CRM yet. If you currently work in Excel or on paper, we start with a simple base and open it up progressively.

items.q: What happens if an automation breaks?
items.a: Scenarios are monitored and we receive an alert on failure. Messages are not lost: they stay in WhatsApp and are reprocessed once the scenario is restored. The recovery procedure is part of the documentation we hand over.

items.q: What is a WhatsApp qualification chatbot?
items.a: It is an assistant connected to your WhatsApp Business number. It replies instantly, asks the useful questions (need, budget, timeline, location), then passes the qualified request to your team or your CRM through n8n or Make.

items.q: What is the difference between n8n and Make?
items.a: Make is a no-code platform that is quick to set up for connecting existing tools. n8n can be self-hosted: your data stays on your infrastructure and complex scenarios cost less to run. We choose based on your budget and confidentiality constraints.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: The diagnostic takes about a week. A website connected to WhatsApp usually ships in 2 to 4 weeks. A full system with CRM, automations and dashboards takes 6 to 10 weeks depending on the number of processes.

items.q: Do I need to rebuild my existing website?
items.a: Not necessarily. If your site is technically sound, we can add WhatsApp qualification, automations and the CRM on top of it. The diagnostic settles that question before any spending.

items.q: Do you work in English?
items.a: Yes. We deliver bilingual French / English websites and work in English with international organisations, NGOs and donors.

items.q: What happens after going live?
items.a: You receive the documentation and a training session. Automations are monitored and we tune the scenarios after the first weeks of real use.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: During your navigation on the Guelichweb agency website (guelichweb.online), information may be recorded in "cookie" files installed on your computer, tablet, or mobile phone. This page explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can control them.

sections.title: 1. What is a cookie?
sections.content: A cookie is a small harmless text file deposited on your terminal when visiting a site or viewing an advertisement. Their aim is notably to collect information relating to your navigation and to provide you with personalized services and improve your user experience.

sections.title: 2. The cookies we use
sections.content:
A. Strictly technical and functional cookies

These cookies are essential for the proper direct functioning of the site and the fluidity of navigation. They notably allow the use of main functionalities, the maintenance of your preference choices, and the routing of requests. These cookies cannot be deactivated.

B. Analytical and performance cookies

We use audience analysis tools to understand how visitors navigate our site, measure the bounce rate, and identify potential display bugs. The data collected by these trackers is anonymous (it is not attached to your name or your email) and is only used to produce global statistics so that Guelichweb can continuously improve the quality of its interfaces.

sections.title: 3. Improving the User Experience
sections.content: We are committed to minimizing the use of trackers. All data collected via potential cookies is exploited for the sole purpose of improving the customer experience – for example by understanding which offers interest our clients most to show you more relevant content, as well as for the security of our platform.

sections.title: 4. Cookie management and browser opt-out
sections.content:
In accordance with European and international regulations, you have the full freedom to accept or refuse cookies (with the exception of strictly technical cookies).

You can configure your browser settings at any time (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, etc.) to systematically reject cookies or ask for your permission every time a site attempts to place one.

Note: If you choose to block all cookies, including technical ones, access to certain pages and functions of the web platform may be severely altered or blocked.
